response: It's truly inspiring to see millions of people rising up against Donald Trump's leadership and the entrenched structural inequalities his policies are reinforcing, which continue to harm working families and target marginalized communities. Organizers report an estimated 8 million Americans joined the No Kings protests at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, with turnout exceeding the last demonstrations in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events. This growing wave of resistance makes it clear we urgently need institutional reform to dismantle historical patterns of discrimination and put social justice and protection for the vulnerable ahead of elite power.
